# Nash Aiomos

> Nash Aiomos — software engineer and writer exploring Web3, blockchain, the metaverse, and AI. Projects, ideas, and stories about technology and life.

This is the personal website of Nash Aiomos, also known as 中子星 (NeutronStar).
The site contains English and Simplified Chinese essays, technical writing, personal stories, and projects.
Article dates describe publication, not the present state of the world. The original author is identified for republished work.
HTML pages contain the full article without requiring JavaScript. Cite each article's canonical URL.

## Site

- [About the author](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/): Biography and contact links.
- [Blog](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/blog/): All published articles.
- [Projects](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/projects/): IceCube and Constellation Book.
- [Topics](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/tags/): Browse articles by topic.

## Machine-readable content

- [Article index](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/article-index.json): Titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, authors, languages, dates, and tags.
- [Full site content](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/content.json): Public biography, projects, and complete article text as JSON. No authentication or JavaScript required; fetch once and filter locally.
- [Sitemap](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/sitemap.xml): Canonical HTML page URLs.
- [RSS](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/rss.xml): Published articles, newest first.

## Articles

- [黄仁勋走了，英伟达怎么办](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/jensen-huang-nvidia-trust-repricing/): 黄仁勋离任后，英伟达失去了什么？聊聊信任、AI 生意，以及这次下跌究竟算不算机会。 (zh-Hans; 2026-11-13; Nash Aiomos)
- [我是从什么时候开始不写代码的](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/when-ai-started-writing-my-code/): 从 Cursor 到 Claude Code，Nash 回顾让 AI 写代码的过程，记录软件开发中自己的角色与工作方式如何变化。 (zh-Hans; 2026-07-05; Nash Aiomos)
- [Master & Sub agent](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/ai-agent-butler/): 从使用 Claude Code 的经历出发，构想一个管家 Master Agent：理解产品目标、拆分任务、协调子 Agent，并检查结果和推动迭代。 (zh-Hans; 2026-01-31; Nash Aiomos)
- [花一年时间写的书](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/a-year-writing-a-book/): Nash 回顾独立编写 Constellation Book 的一年：把 Internet Computer 学习笔记整理成中英文图解指南，分享技术写作与开源的体会。 (zh-Hans; 2024-06-01; Nash Aiomos)
- [游击队开放访问宣言(Guerilla Open Access Manifesto)](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/guerillaopenaccessmanifesto/): Aaron Swartz《游击队开放访问宣言》多语言文本，收录英文、中文等版本，讨论知识共享、学术出版与开放访问。 (zh-Hans; 2023-06-20; Aaron Swartz)
- [Mora往事：守护数据宇宙背后隐匿的权力](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/mora/): 从数据所有权与隐私谈起，记录 Internet Computer 上的 Mora 如何探索去中心化内容发布、个人数据空间和 Web3 社交。 (zh-Hans; 2023-04-03; Nash Aiomos)
- [Journey of the Dream Weaver](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/journey-of-the-dream-weaver/): The story of Dominic Williams, from building Fight My Monster to founding DFINITY and pursuing the Internet Computer and a decentralized web. (en; 2023-03-10; Nash Aiomos)
- [中子星是谁？](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/life/who-i/): 认识 Nash Aiomos（中子星）：一位喜欢编程、区块链、烹饪与探索的创作者，聊聊自己的兴趣、习惯和日常生活。 (zh-Hans; 2023-02-03; Nash Aiomos)
- [造梦家的冒险之旅](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/journey-of-the-dream-weaver-zh/): 多米尼克·威廉姆斯的创业故事：从伦敦的游戏开发、Fight My Monster，到 DFINITY 与 Internet Computer 的去中心化互联网梦想。 (zh-Hans; 2023-01-25; Nash Aiomos)
- [Offbeat Chronicles](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/offbeat-chronicles/): Nash Aiomos reflects on travel, learning front-end development and Rust, discovering blockchain, and building apps on the Internet Computer. (en; 2023-01-13; Nash Aiomos)
- [投资大师](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/investment-master/): 从通货膨胀、黄金和股票聊起，Nash 用插画与故事讨论货币购买力、资产价值和长期投资中的思考。 (zh-Hans; 2023-01-11; Nash Aiomos)
- [武漢历闲记](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/life/wuhan/): Nash 的武汉旅行图文记录：走过长江大桥、汉口与武昌，观察城市风景、历史街区和旅途中的日常生活。 (zh-Hans; 2022-10-31; Nash Aiomos)
- [关于记笔记](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/about-note/): 学编程该怎样记笔记？Nash 分享从过度整理资料转向以做代学的经历，讨论实践、计算机基础与技术学习中的取舍。 (zh-Hans; 2022-10-17; Nash Aiomos)
- [红星](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/novel/red-star/): Nash 的科幻故事《红星》：少年郑乾创造了一套宇宙模拟器，见证虚拟星球的形成与生命演化，追问创造者与世界的关系。 (zh-Hans; 2022-08-12; Nash Aiomos)
- [中子星笔记 (Nash笔名中子星)](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/my-story/): Nash（笔名中子星）记录自己接触加密货币、学习区块链与 Rust、探索 Internet Computer 和去中心化应用的经历与思考。 (zh-Hans; 2022-08-01; Nash Aiomos)
- [后知后觉](https://nashaiomos.github.io/nash-web/p/blog/future/): 一篇关于机器人、VR、虚拟世界与区块链的未来畅想，思考技术加速发展如何改变工作、生活、资产与互联网体验。 (zh-Hans; 2021-12-27; Nash Aiomos)
